title: Verdict: Encode Once, Decide Many
abstract: arXiv:2610.20778v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Automating organizational work means answering many small typed questions about one piece of state (does this email need a reply, how urgent is it, who owns it) with probabilities good enough to act on without a human. The open typed-decision model we compare against, like a standard cross-encoder, answers each question with a separate pass over the input. We present Verdict-MQ, an open encoder that reads a case once and answers all of its questions: given identical retained state tokens after truncation (verified on every reported case), a structured attention mask makes the state encoding independent of the questions, keeps questions from influencing each other, and makes option order irrelevant by construction. translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.20778v1 公告类型：cross 摘要：自动化组织工作意味着对同一份状态数据回答许多小型的类型化问题（这封邮件是否需要回复、紧急程度如何、由谁负责），且其概率要好到足以在无需人工的情况下直接执行。我们对比的开源类型化决策模型，如同标准的交叉编码器，对每个问题都需要对输入进行一次单独的完整遍历。我们提出 Verdict-MQ，一种开源编码器，只需读取案例一次即可回答其所有问题：在截断后保留完全相同的状态标记的前提下（每个报告的案例均已验证），结构化注意力掩码使状态编码独立于问题、避免问题之间相互影响，并通过构造使选项顺序不产生任何影响。在类型化决策基准上，395M 参数的 Verdict-MQ 在全部五个全新随机种子上均显著优于已发布的 421M Laya 专用模型，与软金标准标签的匹配度更高（KL 0.080 对 0.117，Brier 0.045 对 0.061），这一优势……
tldr: Verdict-MQ 提出一种“一次编码、多问题并行回答”的开源编码器，通过结构化注意力掩码实现状态编码与问题解耦、问题互不干扰及选项顺序无关，在类型化决策基准上以更小参数量在所有随机种子上显著超越专用模型。
en_tdlr: Verdict-MQ is an open encoder that reads a case once and answers all typed decision questions in parallel, using a structured attention mask to ensure question-independent state encoding, mutual question isolation, and order invariance by construction, significantly outperforming a larger specialist model across all seeds on the typed-decisions benchmark.
